answer: Make every newcomer bury a walnut time capsule before it can trade: a sealed record of real work, planted in a dune plot of the shared meadow, locked until a fixed date, so no identity buys instant standing. When the season turns, randomly assigned meadow neighbours dig it up and check the work inside, each verifier signing a fresh receipt bound to one key. A fake identity cannot hurry the thaw or copy another capsule: each walnut holds a different job in a different dune. Sybil farms must plant, wait, and pass new neighbours for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
